title: Vision evidence from a local Qwen VLM makes correction-LLM repair beat numeric-only repair
hypothesis: Adding a validated visual failure analysis (Qwen VL on the five rule-selected frames of the parent's worst <=3 failed screen episodes, merged with the numbers by lares.vision.merge) to the Stage F numeric evidence packet lets the correction LLM localise the failing component, so its repairs win more held-out episodes than the identical numeric-only arm at the same repair-episode cap.

prediction.against: arm llm_numeric (Stage F numeric packet, same structures, seeds, refit, acceptance rule and episode cap); paired per replicate (structure x seed), t interval over 9 replicates; no_repair reported as a second control
prediction.rationale: Stage F LLM arms were flat (-0.004 to +0.011 vs no_repair) and intervention evidence gave the only LLM wins, so richer localising evidence is the open lever; +0.05 is the smallest held-out gain that would justify a VLM in the loop. With 9 replicates this is a pilot: a positive mean with an interval spanning zero is inconclusive.

code_changes: lares/repair/correction.py (new evidence level numeric_vision and arm llm_numeric_vision; ArmContext.vision_fn)
lares/vision/analyst.py (QwenAnalyst: pinned checkpoint and fp16/4-bit load on the T4; no other change)
scripts/stage_f.py (vision arm wiring, --vision-model; held-out manifest from pool seed 2620)
config/stage_f_vision/stage_f_vision.yaml (new: arms no_repair, llm_numeric, llm_numeric_vision; Stage F structures)
.venv-metaworld on the GPU box: install transformers/accelerate (+ bitsandbytes if 4-bit) and pull the checkpoint

falsified_by: Upper bound of the paired interval (vision minus numeric) <= 0 refutes any added value; upper bound below 0.05 refutes the predicted magnitude; an interval spanning zero with a positive mean is inconclusive. Also reported: analyses rejected by the schema (uncited frames, unmeasurable checks) and vision/geometry conflicts; if most analyses are rejected the arm did not test vision at all, and the result is recorded as inconclusive.

cost_estimate.breakdown: 9 replicates x (40 common preprocessing + 2 LLM arms x <=40 + <=3 media reruns + 3 arms x 50 held-out) ~ 2460; LLM <=4 calls per LLM arm x 2 x 9 = 72; VLM <=3 per replicate
